name: Baywood/Los Osos Farmers' Market
tagline: Baywood/Los Osos Certified Farmers Market in Baywood, CA
description: Baywood/Los Osos Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 1300 2nd St., CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
